newsitem.title: UK: Holders of two Hanson dlr bonds sign demerger deal.
newsitem.headline: Holders of two Hanson dlr bonds sign demerger deal.

text.p: Holders of two dollar bond issues issued by a Hanson Plc subsidiary have agreed to the deals' terms and conditions being amended as part of the company's ongoing demerger, Hanson said in a statement on Thursday.
The two bonds, each $750 million in size, are Hanson Overseas BV's 7.375 percent bond due 2003 and its 6.75 percent bond due 2005.
Hanson said substantially more than 50 percent of the holders of each bond had agreed to the changes.
Holders of the 2003 deal will receive a one-off payment of 0.75 percent of face value, 2005 holders will receive 1.00 percent.
